notes.title: Version 1.04 out now
notes.content:
Hey guys!

We have been listening to your feedback and bug reports very closely and have implemented a number of updates which should help make your experience with Astral Traveler more fantastic. Here are the bigger points you should be aware of:

[list]
[*] A number of UI navigation issues
[*] Most maps have been tweeked for errors, such as wrong textures, but the layout itself remains untouched.
[*] Errors were removed in the text.
[*] When disconnected from Steam, the beetle replacing the leaderboard no longer hides the menu
[*] When offline with friends, no longer marked as disconnected from steam
[*] Checkpoints wouldn't work when reloading certain levels
[*] Current player's name wouldn't be highlighted in leaderboards when too long
[*] Resolution issues, especially with 4:3 aspect ratios
[*] Maps reload properly after extended periods of play
[*] Ghost no longer flickers annoyingly
[/list]

Unfortunately, we had to delete the ghost data from the game in order to implement the newer, better system. It won't affect any of your scores, just the ghost. We apologize for the inconvenience.

Please keep letting us know about any issues about the game and we'll continue dealing with those. Here is how to contact me:

Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/dragon_slumber] https://twitter.com/dragon_slumber[/url]
Twitch: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/dragonslumber/]https://www.twitch.tv/dragonslumber/[/url]

Take care!
